title: マイクロ・ナノ加工
subtitle: Micro-Nano Processing
keywords: Micro- and nanotechnology 2.MEMS and superfine machining 3.Ultra-precision cutting 4.Grinding and polishing 5.Surface modification
educationalGoal: Currently, technologies for realizing ultrafine parts and mechanisms are required for manufacturing, and these technologies are applied to pressure sensors, the heads of inkjet printers, MEMS such as gyroscopes, manufacture of Si-IC and LED substrates, and micro-machines. In addition, processing methods include not only top-down types that refine existing elements but bottom-up types that build up atoms according to the purpose. In this course, students will learn the basics of processing methods to obtain such ultrafine parts and mechanisms.
advice: We will cover various leading-edge processes that can fabricate micro- to nanoscale parts. The outline of this class is shown below: 1. Relationship between the processing method and scale concepts expressed as micro, meso, and nano 2. Latest top-down micro-processing methods 3. Micro-processing using lasers 4. Planarization processing of Si wafers 5. Planarization processing using chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) methods 6. Outline of surface modification methods 7. Outline of MEMS 8. Summary To deepen your understanding of the content of this course, exercise questions will be presented and explained appropriately. Students will need to bring a scientific calculator to class. In addition, special classes will be held for outside lecturers as needed.
requiredKnowledge: Fully understand related subjects as integrated research and development. Possess fundamental knowledge of elemental technology learned in processing-related subjects

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the concept of dimensions expressed at the micro-, meso-, and nanoscales.
Be able to explain the principles and features of surface modification methods (PVD, CVD, etc.).
Be able to explain the characteristics and principles of ultraprecision polishing.
Be able to explain the processing principles and application examples of the latest micro-processing technology.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Explain the concept of dimensions expressed at the micro-, meso-, and nanoscales and the modification methods for material forming at these dimensions. 2. Explain surface modification methods and the functional thin film that they realize. 3. Explain the positioning and principles of ultraprecision polishing, the polishing conditions, and the method for selecting auxiliary materials consumed during its application. 4. Explain the latest processing methods and application examples that realize ultrafine dimensions.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Explain the concept of dimensions expressed at the micro-, meso-, and nanoscales. 2. Explain the principles of typical surface modification methods. 3. Explain the positioning and principles of ultraprecision polishing, and the method for selecting materials consumed during its application. 4. Explain the principles of the latest processing methods to realize shapes with extremely small dimensions.

lessons.content: Use the syllabus to review the learning outline and action goals of this course. It is necessary to understand which part of the educational objectives of the department of mechanical engineering is covered by this course, and also to understand the standard of the concrete achievement level. Learn the basics of micro-processing and learn the size concepts of the Micro-, Meso- and Nano- scales.

Learn about ultra-precision machining technology and its necessity (i.e., concepts of micro-cutting mechanisms, problems in ultra-precision turning, and influence of thermal deformation on machining accuracy).
Learn about applications of micro-cutting technology and peripheral technologies to enable it (such as optical element dies, micro-tools, processing devices, and control).

Learn about micro-fabrication techniques using high-energy beam machining (such as types of lasers, processing principles, and applications). Self-reflection class: To solve the questions and reinforce your knowledge, review the previous lectures.
Learn the meaning and necessity of the polishing process. Learn about the grinding process in abrasive processing method.
Learn about lapping and polishing in abrasive grain processing methods.
Test on the content of classes 1-6. General Exercise: Case studies of micro-machinin g technology used in various fields will be introduced and future developments will be di scussed.
lessons.assignments: Understand and review class notes, the textbook, and reference materials thoroughly .

lessons.content: Special lectures on ultra-precision processing inviting experts from manufacturer and/or instit ute.
lessons.assignments: Understand and review Lecture notes and reference materials thoroughly.

lessons.content: Learn the basics of vacuums, which are strongly related to nanotechnology and processing technol ogy.
Learn other basic vacuum concepts. Also, understand the unit that represents pressu re.
Learn about the basics of plasma, which is deeply related to surface modification. Learn about specific surface modification methods, such as CVD and PVD.
lessons.assignments: Research commercial surface modification equipment after the lecture. Understand industrial usage and industrial products.

lessons.content: Learn the crystallographic features of Si used in the field of micro- and nano-processing, and the manufacturing method for Si single crystal.
lessons.operation: Lecture Q&A session Practice exercises and explanations
lessons.assignments: Review Bravais lattice and Miller index in advance.

lessons.content: Integrated learning: review the content of classes 9-12. Self-reflection class: To solve the questions and reinforce your knowledge, review the previous lectures.
lessons.assignments: Start investigation of the assigned report. Present the report assignment

lessons.content: Quiz: Check your level of understanding of lectures from classes 11-13. Integrated learning: Study the relationship between the functions of smartphones and nanotechnology and specific functional thin films. Discuss future developments.
Self-reflection class: Review the graded quiz. Review and explain the answers. Comment on the graded reports. Self-check: Self-check of the quiz and report. Consider the future learning plan.
lessons.operation: Explanation of the quiz and report Comment on the lectures
lessons.assignments: Review the quiz. Create and submit a report.
